text:
sophie_customer: Hey team, customer reports intermittent 413s from /rerank. They sent a large JSON, about 1.6MB. Not sure whether the query, passages, or count is the culprit.

maya_support: Sorry for the pain — can you paste the raw 413 response and a redacted example of their payload? 413 normally means the HTTP body was too large but we should be more specific in responses.

ashok_support: If you can share the query length and number of passages we can rough-estimate tokens. A tiny reproducer curl would help.

sophie_customer: They gave this sanitized curl (sensitive bits removed):

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  -d '{"query":"<very long user query ~9k chars>","passages":[{"id":"1","text":"<doc1 ~120k chars>"},{"id":"2","text":"<doc2 large>"}, ...] }'
```

maya_support: Thanks. Two key things: (1) our gateway (nginx) enforces a hard request-body size in bytes before the app sees it, and (2) tokenization can blow up counts — 120k chars might be ~30k tokens depending on language.

ashok_support: Can you repro quickly by trimming the query to ~1k chars and sending only 5 passages? That will tell us whether aggregate body size is the blocker.

sophie_customer: Did that — truncated query + 5 passages succeeded. So aggregate size is the issue. Customer wants clearer guidance: 413 response just says \"Payload too large\" with zero hint about which field or approximate token count caused it.

luis_docs: Noted. We should add doc KB + adjust error payload. Idea: 413 response include a small helper like {"failing_field": "passages", "body_size_bytes": 1654321, "approx_tokens": 32000, "hint": "try snippeting or prefiltering with embeddings"}.

maya_support: Escalating to eng: @ryan_eng can you check infra logs for thread 1809999999? We need to know if the request was dropped by gateway (size in bytes) or rejected by app token checks. Also any interim workaround we can give the customer now.

ryan_eng: Checked logs: gateway rejected the request at ~1.6MB (nginx configured limit). App-level token caps are higher (~50k tokens) but never got the request because of the upstream limit. I'll open a short task to add body_size to 413s from the gateway and a follow-up to add failing_field after app-level checks.

ryan_eng: Short-term workaround we can tell them: (A) submit excerpts (first ~4k chars) for long docs, (B) use embeddings to pre-filter to top-K candidates then call rerank, or (C) chunk documents client-side and rerank chunks progressively.

ashok_support: Also propose a client-side helper to estimate tokens. We typically recommend staying under ~30k tokens for rerank payloads. I'll attach a snippet for splitting/snippeting.

sophie_customer: Customer worried about accuracy and billing if they reduce passages. They asked if we can do server-side auto-snippeting to avoid client changes.

maya_support: Offer options: (1) client-side snippeting = quickest, (2) embed+prefilter = better accuracy/cost tradeoff, (3) we change server error UX to be explicit and explore a later opt-in server-side snippeting feature.

ryan_eng: Created ENG-4209: \"rerank: surface failing_field & approx_token_count on 413s\". Full rollout in ~3 sprints. I can patch staging to include body_size_bytes in the 413 within 48 hours for faster signal.

luis_docs: I'll draft a KB article: reproducer examples and an SDK helper. Proposed recommendations: docs_count <= 50, doc_excerpt <= 4k chars, query <= 2k chars (adjust per customer). Include sample curl and code.

maya_support: Suggested reply to customer (sending now):
\"Thanks — this hit the HTTP gateway body-size limit. Quick fixes: (1) send shortened excerpts (first ~4k chars per doc), (2) run an embeddings prefilter to reduce to top-K then rerank, or (3) chunk and rerank progressively. We're rolling a small update so 413s will include body_size_bytes; fuller field-level hints coming soon.\"

ashok_support: I'll send the reply. If they want a sample SDK snippet in Node/Python, I can paste one.

sophie_customer: They requested both Node and Python examples before we close the ticket.

maya_support: Node snippet to include in KB:

```
// simple excerpt helper
function excerpt(text, max = 4000){
  return text && text.length <= max ? text : text.slice(0, max);
}
const payload = {
  query: excerpt(userQuery, 2000),
  passages: docs.map(d => ({ id: d.id, text: excerpt(d.text, 4000) }))
};
```

maya_support: Python splitter to add to KB as well. Will follow up in the ticket once ENG-4209 lands. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: [deploy] staging: add-413-body-size => success

ryan_eng: Staging now returns 413 with a small JSON body that includes \"body_size_bytes\". Will monitor for edge cases and then iterate toward adding \"failing_field\" when app sees token caps.

maya_support: Thanks all — I'll update the customer and leave this open until we confirm ENG-4209 deploy to prod.
